node.title: Guarded LS6 pairs have low cross determinant, with distance-only closure fenced
node.statement: For every fixed guarded LS6 atom and every candidate D, its quotient Q in DE=MQ+V has degree e-a, fixed leading coefficient, and gcd(D,Q)=1. For two distinct candidates, H_12=D_1Q_2-D_2Q_1=(D_2V_1-D_1V_2)/M is nonzero of degree at most ell-2a. Hence gcd(D_1,D_2)|H_12, their root sets intersect in at most ell-2a points, and fixing one candidate injects all others into the nonzero H-polynomials of that degree. The associated constant-weight Johnson denominator is exactly j^2-N(ell-2a)=J<=0 on the live tail, so this sharp pairwise cap cannot itself give the required polynomial payment. The remaining route must use collective Pade/split structure.
